eventTypes.label: A workflow finished
eventTypes.description: Another workflow completed (with or without node errors). Pin a source canvas to follow one workflow.

eventTypes.label: A notification was raised
eventTypes.description: The site raised an owner notification (after the ledger row is written). A workflow never re-triggers itself off its own notifications.

eventTypes.label: WhatsApp message from you
eventTypes.description: You sent the site a WhatsApp message. Filter on text, e.g. text contains "lights".

eventTypes.label: Email arrived on a watch
eventTypes.description: A Gmail watch saw a new message. Filter on from, subject or watchLabel.

eventTypes.label: New stories on the news desk
eventTypes.description: The desk stored stories it had never seen. One event per gather, carrying every new story, not one event per story.

eventTypes.label: High-significance intel alert
eventTypes.description: The intelligence engine raised a high-significance alert inside your scope.

eventTypes.label: Health figures moved
eventTypes.description: The health watcher saw your headline figures change (checked every 15 minutes).

eventTypes.label: Something was said to Alexa
eventTypes.description: A new utterance reached the voice log (synced every 5 minutes). Filter on command, device or room.

eventTypes.label: Whoop recovery synced
eventTypes.description: A health sync stored new Whoop recovery records.
